description.value: You repair a single break or tear in an object you touch — a snapped chain link, the two halves of a broken key, a torn strap, a leaking container — provided the damage spans no more than 1 foot in any dimension, leaving no trace it was ever broken. If the target is a droid or construct, it may instead spend and roll one of its Hit Dice, regaining that many hit points.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
